definitions.explanation: The study or acquisition of foreign languages.

examples.japanese: {語学|ごがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{語学|ごがく}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I want to go study abroad for language learning.

examples.japanese: {語学|ごがく}⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。

{語学|ごがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習得|しゅうとく}→習得：13903_shuutoku⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。⟦しかし→しかし：00986_shikashi⟧、⟦{継続|けいぞく}すれば→継続：00213_keizoku⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}する→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧。
examples.english: Acquiring a language requires time and effort. However, if you continue, you will definitely improve.

notes:
{語学|ごがく} refers to language study and language ability.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {語学|ごがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to study languages)
- {語学|ごがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{堪能|たんのう}→堪能：12081_tannou⟧だ (to be proficient in languages)
- {語学|ごがく}⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (language proficiency)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{語学|ごがく}{学校|がっこう}→語学学校：25804_gogakugakkou⟧ (language school)
- {語学|ごがく}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ (study abroad for language learning)
- {語学|ごがく}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧ (language training)
- {語学|ごがく}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (language test)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語学|ごがく}: language study/ability (general)
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}{語|ご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧: foreign language
- ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧{学|がく}: linguistics (academic field)
